title: Thai Lettuce Wraps
description: A refreshing Thai-inspired snack or light meal, featuring crisp lettuce leaves wrapped around a savory filling.

ingredients.name: Irish
ingredients.amount: 100g crisp irish soda bread, torn into small pieces

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the torn soda bread pieces until crispy and lightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the yeast extract and chopped shallots.
Add the mixed salad greens to the bowl and toss to combine.
To assemble the wraps, place a lettuce leaf on a flat surface.
Spoon some of the salad mixture onto the center of the lettuce leaf.
Top with a few pieces of the grilled soda bread.
Fold the lettuce leaf to enclose the filling and serve immediately.
